## New

- **Add styles from the menu.** A + button next to the tabs lists every section with a sample of its icons. Turn one on and its tab shows up right away, without opening the settings.
- **Icons have their own tab.** The 19 colored icons (In progress, Question, Important, Star and the rest) moved out of Basic into an Icons tab, so Basic is just the ten checkbox shapes. The Icons tab is on by default and can be turned off like any other section.

Tasks you already marked keep their look: the character written in the note did not change.
